about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Garlic Chive Layered Pancakes
recipes.summary: Crisp, flaky layered pancakes with garlic chives, pan-fried and cut into wedges for snacking.
steps: Stir the flour with the boiling water until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and rest.
Divide into 4 pieces and roll each into a thin round. Brush with sesame oil and scatter with chives and salt.
Roll each round into a log, coil into a snail and press flat into a 14cm disc.
Fry in the neutral oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Cut into wedges and serve with the soy sauce and rice vinegar mixed together for dipping.
notes: Plus 30 minutes resting the dough.
Snack. Vegan.

recipes.title: Black Sesame Tang Yuan
recipes.summary: Chewy glutinous rice balls filled with sweet black sesame paste, served in warm ginger syrup.
steps: Toast the sesame in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant, then grind to a rough paste with the white sugar and butter. Chill until firm and roll into 16 small balls.
Knead the flour with 3/4 cup water into a soft dough. Flatten pieces, wrap each around a filling ball and roll smooth.
Simmer the 3 cups water with the ginger and brown sugar for 8 minutes until syrupy.
Boil the dumplings in a separate pot of water for 5 minutes, until they float and are tender.
Lift into bowls and ladle over the ginger syrup.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian. Filling chilled before wrapping.

recipes.title: Soy Egg Rice Bowls with Pickled Cucumber
recipes.summary: Marinated soft-set eggs over steamed rice with quick-pickled cucumber and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Simmer the soy sauce, sugar and water for 2 minutes until the sugar dissolves, cool, then steep the eggs in it for at least 1 hour.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Top the rice with halved eggs, cucumber, sesame oil, sesame seed and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: use fresh eggs and keep marinated eggs refrigerated; eat within 2 days. Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Wok-Tossed Cabbage Dumpling Filling Bowls
recipes.summary: Dumpling flavours without the wrapping: pork and cabbage stir-fried over rice with ginger and chilli oil.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then the wombok, soy sauce and wine and toss for 4 minutes until the cabbage wilts.
Stir through the chilli oil and spring onion.
Spoon the pork and cabbage over the rice and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C with no pink remaining.

recipes.title: Silken Tofu and Mushrooms in Chilli Bean Sauce
recipes.summary: Silky tofu and mushrooms in a numbing, spicy bean sauce, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Toast the peppercorns in a dry wok for 1 minute until fragrant, crush, and set aside.
Heat the oil and fry the mushrooms for 4 minutes until browned. Add the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce, add the tofu in cubes and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Stir the cornflour with 2 tbsp water, add and cook for 1 minute until glossy. Top with peppercorns and spring onion over rice.
notes: Vegan. Doubanjiang contains wheat; check labels for gluten.

recipes.title: Steamed Egg Custard with Prawns
recipes.summary: Silky savoury egg custard steamed gently and topped with prawns, soy and spring onion.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the water and a pinch of salt, then strain through a sieve into a shallow heatproof dish.
Cover with foil and steam over gently simmering water for 8 minutes.
Lay the prawns on top, cover and steam for 4 minutes more, until the custard is just set and the prawns are opaque and pink.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with spring onion and pepper.
notes: Food safety: prawns should be opaque and pink and the custard set through to 75°C.

recipes.title: Peanut Candy Sesame Brittle Bars
recipes.summary: Crunchy peanut and sesame brittle set in a tray, snapped into shards.
steps: Line a tray with baking paper and toast the peanuts and sesame in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden.
Boil the sugar, water and golden syrup for 10 minutes until it reaches 150°C and turns light amber.
Stir in the butter and bicarbonate of soda, which will foam, then fold through the peanuts and sesame quickly.
Pour onto the tray, press thin with an oiled spatula and cool for 30 minutes until hard.
Snap the cooled brittle into pieces and store airtight.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian and gluten-free. Hot sugar can cause severe burns; handle with care.

recipes.title: Japanese Sweet Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Fluffy savoury-sweet pancakes with mashed sweet potato and a soy glaze.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until very soft, drain and mash.
Mix in the egg, flour and milk until a thick batter forms.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side over medium heat, until golden.
Simmer the butter, soy sauce and mirin for 1 minute until syrupy.
Brush the glaze over the pancakes and scatter with sesame.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Black Sesame Cream Pudding
recipes.summary: Creamy toasted black sesame pudding, set with cornflour and finished with maple.
steps: Toast the sesame in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant. Warm the milk, cream and sugar until steaming, blend with the sesame and cornflour until smooth, strain and return to the pot.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, whisking until thick and glossy.
Pour into 4 glasses and chill until set.
Spoon over the maple syrup and serve cold.
notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours chilling. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Cold Soba with Sesame Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles with cucumber, nori and a nutty dipping sauce for hot days.
steps: Boil the soba for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse well under cold water and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, vinegar, tahini and sesame oil into a smooth sauce.
Pile the noodles into bowls and top with cucumber, nori and spring onion.
Serve with the sauce for dipping or pouring over.
notes: Vegan. Check soba is 100% buckwheat if avoiding gluten.

recipes.title: Tamago Sando with Pickled Slaw
recipes.summary: Soft, creamy Japanese egg sandwich on white bread with crunchy pickled slaw.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm, then cool in iced water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard and a pinch of salt until creamy.
Toss the cabbage with the vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes.
Butter the bread, pile on the egg and slaw, close and trim the crusts.
notes: Food safety: eggs boiled until the yolk is fully firm; keep refrigerated and eat within a day.

recipes.title: Karaage Chicken Bento Skewers
recipes.summary: Crisp soy-ginger marinated chicken nuggets threaded on skewers, served with lemon.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, mirin, ginger and garlic for 20 minutes.
Toss in the potato starch to coat.
Heat 3cm of oil to 175°C and fry in batches for 5 minutes until deep golden.
Drain on paper, thread onto skewers and serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: fry until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C. Plus 20 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Oyakodon Quick Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Soft-set egg and chicken simmered in dashi, soy and mirin over steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a pan, add the onion and chicken and cook for 6 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Pour the lightly beaten eggs over and cook for 1 minute until just set.
Slide over the rice and top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the eggs are just set.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Mochi Pillows
recipes.summary: Soft stretchy rice-flour mochi wrapped around sweet mashed sweet potato, dusted with starch.
steps: Whisk the flour, water and sugar in a heatproof bowl until smooth.
Microwave covered for 1 minute, stir, then microwave for another 1 minute until thick and translucent.
Tip onto a surface dusted with the potato starch and cool slightly.
Cut into 8 pieces, flatten, wrap each around a ball of sweet potato (boiled for 12 minutes until soft, mashed with 1 tbsp sugar) and pinch closed.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Eat the same day for best texture.

recipes.title: Kimchi Cheese Toastie Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp pan-fried bread rolls stuffed with kimchi and melty cheddar.
steps: Flatten the bread with a rolling pin and trim the crusts.
Mix the kimchi, cheddar and gochujang and spoon along one edge of each slice.
Roll up tightly and press the seam closed.
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 5 minutes, turning until golden all over.
notes: Vegetarian. Kimchi may contain fish sauce; check the label.

recipes.title: Hotteok Cinnamon Pockets
recipes.summary: Chewy griddled Korean sweet pancakes with a brown sugar, cinnamon and walnut filling.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, white sugar, milk and a pinch of salt into a sticky dough. Cover and rise.
Mix the brown sugar, cinnamon and walnuts until combined.
Divide the dough into 6, flatten, add filling to each and pinch closed.
Cook in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, pressing flat, until golden and the sugar has melted.
notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour rising. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Gochujang Egg Drop Toast
recipes.summary: Buttery pan-fried bread topped with a runny egg, gochujang glaze and sesame.
steps: Fry the bread in half the butter for 2 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
In the remaining butter, fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and yolks are soft.
Mix the gochujang and honey until smooth and spread over the toast.
Top with the eggs, sesame and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: soft yolks use raw egg; cook the white through. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Bulgogi Beef Lunch Wraps
recipes.summary: Sweet soy-marinated beef with crisp lettuce, rice and ssamjang in cool leaves.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and pear and marinate the beef for 30 minutes.
Sear the beef in a hot pan in batches for 2 minutes per batch until browned.
Fill lettuce leaves with rice, beef and a dab of ssamjang.
notes: Food safety: sear the thin beef until browned through, at least 71°C. Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Tteokbokki-Style Rice Cakes in Gochujang
recipes.summary: Chewy rice cakes simmered in a sweet-spicy gochujang sauce with fish cakes.
steps: Boil the egg for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Simmer the water, gochujang, soy sauce and sugar in a wide pan for 3 minutes.
Add the rice cakes and fish cakes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft.
Top with the egg and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: reheat fish cakes until hot through to 75°C.

recipes.title: Coconut Glutinous Rice Cups with Mango
recipes.summary: Glutinous rice soaked in coconut cream, topped with fresh mango and toasted sesame.
steps: Rinse the rice and steam it over simmering water for 25 minutes until tender.
Warm half the coconut cream with 2 tbsp palm sugar and salt, stir through the hot rice and rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the remaining coconut cream and sugar for a sauce.
Serve the rice with mango, a spoon of sauce and sesame.
notes: Dessert. Plus 30 minutes soaking the rice. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Red Curry Fish Patties with Cucumber
recipes.summary: Bouncy red curry fish cakes fried until golden, with cucumber and sweet chilli dip.
steps: Blend the fish, curry paste, egg and fish sauce into a coarse paste, then fold in the beans and lime leaf.
Shape the mixture into 12 small flat patties with wet hands.
Fry in 1cm of oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the sweet chilli sauce and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish cakes until the centre is opaque and flakes, at 63°C or above.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Egg Fried Rice Cups
recipes.summary: Wok-fried rice with Thai basil, chilli and fried egg, packed into little cups for lunchboxes.

items: 3 cups white rice, cooked and cooled

steps: Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rice, oyster sauce and fish sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly browned.
Fry the eggs separately for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Fold in the basil, spoon the rice into bowls and top with the eggs and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate it within 1 hour, then reheat until piping hot.

recipes.title: Pandan-Free Coconut Custard Pots
recipes.summary: Baked coconut custard with palm sugar, set until just wobbly.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C and set 4 ramekins in a deep tray.
Warm the cream, milk and sugar until the sugar dissolves, then whisk into the eggs with the vanilla and salt.
Strain into the ramekins and pour hot water into the tray to halfway up.
Bake for 30 minutes until set around the edges with a slight wobble in the centre.
Chill the custards in the fridge until cold before serving.
notes: Dessert. Plus 2 hours chilling. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lemongrass and Galangal Noodle Broth
recipes.summary: Hot, sour lemongrass broth with mushrooms, tomato and noodles for a quick lunch.
steps: Simmer the stock with the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaf for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomato and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender and drain into bowls.
Season the broth with fish sauce, lime juice and chilli and ladle over. Top with coriander.
notes: Gluten-free if the stock is.

recipes.title: Banana Blossom Salad with Peanuts
recipes.summary: Shredded banana blossom tossed with lime, chilli and roasted peanuts.
steps: Toss the shredded blossom in lime juice and water for 5 minutes until it stays pale and crisp, then drain.
Dissolve the sugar in the lime juice and fish sauce for the dressing.
Toss the blossom with the shallot, chilli and herbs.
Dress and scatter with peanuts.
notes: Gluten-free. Use soy sauce for a vegan dressing.

recipes.title: Egg Yolk Cream Hot Chocolate
recipes.summary: Rich whipped egg-yolk cream spooned over hot cocoa for a dessert drink.
steps: Whisk the yolks, sugar, condensed milk and vanilla over a pot of simmering water for 5 minutes until thick, pale and 71°C.
Whisk the cocoa into 1 cup hot water with a little sugar until smooth and pour into two cups.
Spoon the custard on top.
notes: Food safety: egg yolks are heated to 71°C to cook through.
Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bánh Mì Pâté Toasts
recipes.summary: Crunchy toasted baguette with pâté, pickled carrot and radish, cucumber and chilli.
steps: Pickle the carrot and daikon in the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for 15 minutes.
Split and toast the baguette until crisp.
Spread with pâté and layer with cucumber, pickles, coriander and chilli.
notes: Pâté contains liver; pregnant people should avoid it.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Pork Rice Paper Rolls
recipes.summary: Fresh rolls with lemongrass pork, vermicelli and herbs, served with peanut dip.
steps: Mix the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and sugar and fry for 7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender.
Dip a wrapper in water, fill with pork, noodles, herbs and cucumber and roll tightly.
Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin and a splash of warm water for the dip.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C, with no pink.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Sweet Corn Pudding
recipes.summary: Warm corn and coconut milk pudding thickened with tapioca and finished with toasted peanuts.
steps: Simmer the corn, coconut milk, sugar and salt for 8 minutes.
Stir the starch with 3 tbsp water and whisk in, cooking for 3 minutes until thick.
Serve warm topped with peanuts.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sambal Egg Skewer Bites
recipes.summary: Soft eggs rolled in spicy sambal and grilled on skewers.
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Fry the garlic and sambal in the oil for 2 minutes, add the kecap manis and bubble until sticky.
Roll the eggs in the sauce over low heat for 2 minutes until coated.
Thread onto skewers and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is mostly firm. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pisang-Free Cassava Cake
recipes.summary: Chewy baked coconut cassava cake with a golden top.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20cm tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and oil, then beat in the cassava flour and baking powder.
Pour in, sprinkle with coconut and bake for 45 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free. Cassava is eaten cooked only.

recipes.title: Gado-Gado Lunch Bowl
recipes.summary: Blanched vegetables, tofu and egg with a rich peanut sauce.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Pan-fry the tofu until golden on all sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime juice, garlic, sambal and warm water into a sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and halved eggs on plates and drizzle with sauce.
notes: Vegetarian. Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is firm.

recipes.title: Sambal Tempeh-Style Tofu Rice Boxes
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu tossed in sweet sambal glaze over rice with greens.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the beans, sambal and kecap manis and toss for 3 minutes until sticky.
Serve over rice with lime.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Kuih Lapis Steamed Layer Cake
recipes.summary: Rainbow-layered coconut rice flour cake, steamed in thin layers.
steps: Whisk everything until smooth and divide in two, tinting one half if you like.
Steam a greased tin for 3 minutes, pour in a thin layer and steam for 5 minutes until set.
Repeat layer by layer until the batter is used.
Steam the final layer for 10 minutes, cool completely and slice.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Plus 2 hours cooling.

recipes.title: Roti Canai with Dhal Dip
recipes.summary: Flaky layered Malaysian flatbread torn and dipped in quick lentil dhal.
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water, milk and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough. Rub with ghee and rest.
Simmer the lentils with the water, turmeric, curry powder and onion for 20 minutes until soft.
Stretch each dough ball thin, fold into a square and fry in ghee for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Crush the roti to fluff its layers and serve with the dhal.
notes: Plus 2 hours resting the dough. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Curry Puff Pastry Triangles
recipes.summary: Baked flaky pastry with a spiced potato and pea filling.
steps: Boil the potato for 8 minutes until tender and drain.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add curry powder for 1 minute, then the potato and pea. Mash lightly and cool.
Cut pastry into squares, fill, fold into triangles and seal.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pulut Hitam Black Rice Pudding
recipes.summary: Warm black glutinous rice pudding with coconut cream and palm sugar.
steps: Rinse and soak the rice overnight.
Simmer the rice in the water for 45 minutes until tender and the porridge thickens.
Stir in the palm sugar and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve warm with the coconut cream.
notes: Dessert. Plus overnight soaking. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Turon Banana-Free Mango Spring Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp fried spring roll wrappers with mango and brown sugar, dusted with sugar.
steps: Roll each mango strip in brown sugar and cinnamon until coated.
Wrap in a wrapper, sealing the edges with water.
Fry in 2cm of oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until golden, then drain.
Dust with the caster sugar and serve warm.
notes: Dessert. Vegan.

recipes.title: Pandesal-Style Soft Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft, slightly sweet bread rolls rolled in breadcrumbs, baked until golden.
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and a pinch of salt. Add milk, egg and butter and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Rise until doubled, then shape into 12 rolls and coat with breadcrumbs.
Rest the shaped rolls for 30 minutes until puffy.
Bake at 190°C for 18 minutes until golden.
notes: Plus 90 minutes rising and resting. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinola Lunch Soup
recipes.summary: Gentle ginger chicken soup with green papaya and spinach.
steps: Fry the ginger, garlic and onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes, then add the water and fish sauce.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add the papaya and cook for 6 minutes until tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and no pink should remain.

recipes.title: Leche Flan Cups
recipes.summary: Silky caramel custard baked in cups, rich and smooth.
steps: Melt the sugar in a pot over medium heat until deep amber and divide among 6 ramekins.
Whisk the yolks, condensed milk, milk and vanilla and strain.
Pour into the ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150°C for 40 minutes until set with a gentle wobble.
Chill until cold, then run a knife around each and unmould onto plates.
notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours chilling. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ginisang Sweet Potato Fritters
recipes.summary: Crispy sweet potato fritters with garlic and spring onion, served with vinegar dip.
steps: Mix the potato, flour, egg, onion and first garlic with a pinch of salt.
Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Mix the vinegar, extra garlic and chilli for dipping.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Masala Chai Shortbread
recipes.summary: Buttery spiced tea shortbread, crisp and tender.
steps: Beat the butter and icing sugar until pale.
Mix in the flour, cornflour and spices to a soft dough, chill and roll out.
Cut into rounds and bake at 160°C for 18 minutes until pale golden.
notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Besan Ladoo Sweet Balls
recipes.summary: Roasted chickpea flour and ghee balls with cardamom, soft and melting.
steps: Roast the flour in the ghee over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring until fragrant and golden.
Cool until just warm, stir in the sugar and cardamom.
Roll into 12 balls and press a pistachio into each.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Paneer Kathi Rolls
recipes.summary: Spiced paneer wrapped in flaky rotis with onions and mint chutney.
steps: Coat the paneer in the paste, spices and yoghurt for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes until browned on all sides.
Warm the rotis and fill with paneer, onion and chutney. Roll tight.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Masala Dosa Lunch Crepes
recipes.summary: Crisp rice-flour crepes filled with spiced potato.
steps: Whisk the flours, water and salt into a thin batter.
Fry the mustard seed and curry leaf in 1 tbsp ghee, add the onion, chilli and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potato and mash lightly.
Pour batter into a hot pan, spread thin and cook with ghee for 3 minutes until crisp, fill and fold.
notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tandoori Chicken Thigh Skewers
recipes.summary: Marinated chicken thigh grilled until charred, with mint raita.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, paste, spices and lemon juice and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto metal or soaked skewers.
Grill over high heat for 12 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with raita and onion.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Rasmalai-Style Cardamom Milk Cakes
recipes.summary: Soft ricotta dumplings steeped in saffron cardamom milk.
steps: Mix the ricotta, flour and semolina into a dough, knead and shape 12 small discs.
Simmer the milk, sugar, cardamom and saffron for 12 minutes until reduced by a third.
Drop in the discs and poach gently for 10 minutes until they swell.
Chill and serve with pistachio.
notes: Dessert. Plus 3 hours chilling. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Kerala Fish Curry Lunch Pots
recipes.summary: Tamarind and coconut fish curry with curry leaves and chilli.
steps: Fry the mustard seed and curry leaf in the oil for 30 seconds until they pop.
Add the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spices, coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flaking at 63°C.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Sambol Toasts
recipes.summary: Zesty fresh coconut sambol piled on crisp toast.
steps: Rub the coconut with the onion, chilli, lime juice and salt until combined.
Toast the sourdough in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Pile the sambol on the toast until generously covered.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Lentil Wraps with Greens
recipes.summary: Red lentil stew in a flatbread wrap with spiced greens.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 18 minutes until thick.
Wilt the kale in the stew for 3 minutes until tender.
Spoon into flatbreads and roll.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Kenyan Coconut Mandazi
recipes.summary: Lightly sweet fried doughnuts scented with cardamom and coconut.
steps: Mix the dry ingredients, then the milk and egg to a soft dough, knead briefly and rest for 15 minutes.
Roll out, cut into triangles.
Fry in hot oil, turning, for 4 minutes until puffed and golden.
Drain the mandazi on paper and serve them warm.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: South African Milk Tart Squares
recipes.summary: Cinnamon-dusted creamy milk custard in a crisp pastry.
steps: Press the pastry into a tin and bake at 190°C for 12 minutes until golden.
Heat 2 1/2 cups milk with the sugar. Whisk the cornflour and eggs into the remaining milk and add, stirring over medium heat for 6 minutes until thick.
Stir in the vanilla and butter and pour into the shell.
Chill, dust with cinnamon and cut into squares.
notes: Dessert. Plus 2 hours chilling. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Boerewors Roll Lunch Sandwich
recipes.summary: Grilled spiced sausage in a roll with tomato relish and onion.
steps: Grill the sausage for 15 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Fry the onion in oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Butter and toast the rolls for 2 minutes until golden, then fill with sausage, onion, tomato sauce and relish.
notes: Food safety: pork sausage must reach 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Pacific Coconut Fish Ceviche Cups
recipes.summary: Lime-cured fish with coconut milk, cucumber and chilli served in cups.
steps: Toss the fish with lime juice and refrigerate for 20 minutes until opaque.
Drain most of the juice and stir in the coconut milk, cucumber, tomato, onion and chilli.
Serve in cups topped with coriander.
notes: Food safety: use very fresh fish; the flesh should turn opaque, or poach to 63°C if unsure. Plus 20 minutes curing. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Samoan Palusami-Style Spinach Parcels
recipes.summary: Spinach leaves in creamy coconut baked in foil.
steps: Mix the onion, tomato, coconut cream, salt and lime.
Pile the spinach on foil squares, spoon over the mixture and seal.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until tender.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
